summary: Verified CSS responsive-width fix (.page-pad width:100% + .card-grid auto-fit). At 1920x800, all 9 target pages (/, /booking, /receive, /transfer, /stock, /offers, /approvals, /stock-count, /money/vendor) render with .page-pad width=1662px, rightGap=0px, leftGap=258px (sidebar) — main panel now fills full available width beside sidebar with zero dead whitespace on right. Booking/Receive card grid: firstCardW=1598/1548px (auto-fit stretching a single card across the full row confirmed). No horizontal scrollbar. Sidebar + topbar + page headers render normally on all tested pages. At 1280x800, dashboard measures padW=1022 rightGap=0 (1280-258 sidebar=1022) confirming responsive adaptation. 1280/1024 measurements on additional pages were blocked by Vite proxy 429 rate-limit artifacts (documented in review request as non-app-bug); layout CSS is width:100%/box-sizing so scaling is deterministic. Fix is working as intended.
critical_code_review_comments: CSS fix is minimal and correct: .page-pad now uses width:100%;box-sizing:border-box; and .card-grid uses grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(320px,1fr)). Both changes are the standard textbook approach for the exact issue reported.

Note: .page-pad has no max-width now, so on ultrawide monitors (e.g. 2560px+) content will span the full width. If future stakeholders want a comfort cap for reading, consider max-width:1600-1800px with margin:auto on very wide screens — but per current bug report, no cap is intentional.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the CSS width fix at 1920; 1280 partially blocked by preview proxy 429s but dashboard confirmed responsive

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend runs behind Vite dev proxy that aggressively rate-limits 429 on rapid /src/*.tsx and /@vite/client requests. Pace page navigations with 3s+ waits. Login: goto /login, fill #username='owner' + #password='Owner@123', click [data-testid="login-submit"]. Note: clicking [data-testid="demo-owner"] alone does not fill fields — it did not auto-populate in this environment, so manual fill is needed. Sidebar occupies 258px at 1920 viewport; .page-pad element is the main-content wrapper on most pages.
rca of the issue: Original bug: .page-pad had max-width:1320px causing dead whitespace to the right on wide viewports. Fix (already applied by main agent) removes the cap by setting width:100% + box-sizing:border-box, and switches .card-grid from auto-fill to auto-fit so a lone card stretches across empty tracks. Verified: at 1920 viewport (sidebar 258px), .page-pad now occupies the full remaining 1662px with rightGap=0, and a single booking card stretches to 1598px filling its grid track.
